description: Source code for Android's SurfaceTexture JNI wrapper and related native functions, managing surface textures, buffers, and OpenGL context attachment.

classes.name: ASurfaceTexture
classes.description: Native structure holding references to SurfaceTexture and IGraphicBufferProducer objects.

methods.name: SurfaceTexture_classInit
methods.description: Initializes JNI field IDs for SurfaceTexture class.

methods.name: register_android_graphics_SurfaceTexture
methods.description: Registers JNI class and caches field IDs.

methods.name: android_SurfaceTexture_isInstanceOf
methods.description: Checks if a jobject is an instance of SurfaceTexture.

methods.name: SurfaceTexture_getSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Retrieves native SurfaceTexture pointer from Java object.

methods.name: SurfaceTexture_getProducer
methods.description: Retrieves native IGraphicBufferProducer pointer from Java object.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_fromSurfaceTexture
methods.description: Creates native ASurfaceTexture from Java SurfaceTexture object.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_attachToGLContext
methods.description: Attaches surface texture to OpenGL context.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_detachFromGLContext
methods.description: Detaches surface texture from OpenGL context.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_updateTexImage
methods.description: Updates the texture image from the buffer queue.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_getTransformMatrix
methods.description: Retrieves the transform matrix for the surface texture.

methods.name: ASurfaceTexture_getTimestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the current buffer.
